summary: Iteration 215aa — Family Auto-Bill feature testing. All backend tests passed (16/16): 4 unit tests + 12 API tests. Member-side endpoints (GET/POST auto-pay status, setup, disable) work correctly with proper auth. Operator endpoint (GET autopay/members) works correctly. Regression tests for sibling discount (215z) and family grouping (215y) all pass. Frontend AutoPayCard component verified with correct data-testid attributes. InvoicingTab has correct Auto badge data-testid attributes.

integration_issues.issue: Session management issue - login modal appears but doesn't persist session when navigating to /memberships. This is a known issue from iteration 215z.

InvoicingTab.js has correct Auto badge data-testid attributes (mbr-invoicing-autopay-{member_id}, mbr-invoicing-history-autopay-{inv_id})
